 Anthony Edwards and the Minnesota Timberwolves have a showdown with Kawhi Leonard and the Toronto Raptors on Sunday.
 The Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0) end the first week of the 2026-2027 NBA season in a showdown with the Toronto Raptors (2-0) in a matchup of undefeated teams. Minnesota is playing great team basketball, with the sixth-highest scoring offense and the fourth-best defense in the league. Anthony Edwards came out of the gate with 45 points and 10 rebounds on 9-for-17 shooting. He followed that up with a 15-point performance, leading seven players in double figures. Toronto is off to an equally impressive start, led by the return of 2019 NBA Finals MVP Kawhi Leonard. They have the fifth-best scoring offense and third-best defense in the first week of the season.

 Leonard is blending into a dynamic Toronto team that is looking to break through in the Eastern Conference. He is averaging 19.5 points, 7.5 rebounds, and 3.5 steals in 26.0 minutes per game.
 Sixth-year forward Scottie Barnes is leading Toronto early in the season. He is averaging 25.5 points, 10.0 rebounds and 5.0 assists per game.
 RJ Barrett (21.5 points) and Immanuel Quickley (17.5 points) are also averaging double figures to help balance the offense. Second-year forward Collin Murray-Boyles is coming off the bench for 7.0 points, 5.5 rebounds, and 2.0 steals per game after an impressive rookie season.
